overviewTitle:
A little closer.
A little more connected.
overviewDescription: Explore a calmer way to stay connected. This preview uses fictional people and locations.
languageNote: Choose the language that feels familiar.
languageError: Your language changed, but could not be saved. Try selecting it again.
mapCardBody: Two example participants. One shared view. Try movement and connection changes.
componentsCardBody: Readable type, clear actions, and room to breathe. Explore the building blocks.
demoOnly: Simulation only · No location is collected or shared.
componentsDescription: A preview of the controls and states that will shape EvacuAid.
typeBody: Important information should stay readable, even when you make your text larger.
typeCaption: SF Pro (iOS) · Inter (Android) · Regular / Medium / Semibold / Bold
disabledReason: Real buddy invitations are not part of this preview.
nameDescription: Use a fictional name in this preview.
inputValid: Name entered. Nothing has been sent.
sheetBody: In the future app, sharing your location will be an explicit choice. This preview does not collect or share location.
infoState: Preview ready. All participants are fictional.
warningState: Updates may be out of date. Check the last update time.
errorState: Connection interrupted. Your last known information stays visible.
mapDescription: Explore the map with two fictional participants near central Jakarta.
mapLabel: Map of two fictional participants. The same positions are listed below.
mapKeyMissing: Android map configuration is missing. Add the Google Maps key and rebuild to show the basemap. The simulated participant list works below.
mapPaused: Return to this screen to start a fresh simulation.
mapFooter: An old position does not mean someone is still there. This preview demonstrates freshness, not a live sharing service.
welcomeBody: Official alerts, evacuation guidance and help from people you trust, delivered the way you need. No account needed.
supportBody: Choose what fits, as many as you like. This sets how warnings, navigation and help appear. You can change it anytime.
largerTextDescription: Enlarge app content in addition to your iPhone text settings.
strongerContrastDescription: Make secondary information darker and easier to distinguish.
voiceEnabledDescription: Use speech to present important information.
vibrationEnabledDescription: Use vibration to mark important information.
futureSupport: Your device’s screen reader and accessibility settings work throughout the app.
setupSaveError: Could not save your preferences. Please try again.
localPreferences: Preferences sync to your guest profile. First-time setup status stays on this device.
logoutErrorBody: Your changes could not be saved. Please try again.
apiNetworkUnavailable: Can't reach the API. Make sure the backend is running and this device can reach the computer hosting it.
startNewGuestBody: This device cannot recover the old profile. This creates a new guest profile.
sampleExplanation: Fictional examples to explore the app. Not live information.
rainSummary: Read the warning and find your next step.
rainBody: Moderate to heavy rain, with possible lightning and strong winds in the area.
waterSummary: An observation in the selected area.
waterBody: Water has been reported on a local road. The location, depth, and road access have not been verified.
waterValidity: Observed 07:00 WIB, 17 Sep 2026; no verified validity period
buddyShortcut: Prepare a request to someone you trust
nextStepsBody: Review the information, consider what support you need, and check the details of a destination before making a decision.
alertLimit: Reading a warning does not confirm your safety.
buddyIntro: Choose someone you know, then tell them what you need.
draftOnly: Draft only. Kept while the app is open; nothing is sent.
contactsUnavailable: Invitations, calls, and live contact availability are not connected yet.
contactExplanation: This fictional contact lets you prepare and review a help request. Their availability is unknown.
sharingOff: Location sharing is off. No message or location is sent.
discardBody: The message you have written will be removed.
messageRequired: Write a message before reviewing your request.
sendingExplanation: Your draft is ready to review, but Buddy messaging is not connected. No one has received this request.
requestIncomplete: Choose a contact and write a message first.
chooseContact: Choose a trusted contact to start your request.
contentUnavailable: This information is unavailable. Go back to choose another item.
noAlerts: No warning information is available. This does not mean the area is safe.
noContacts: No trusted contacts are available yet.
preferencePreviewBody: Important information, with room to read.
profileDetails: Name and phone are optional. Add assistance and accessibility needs if useful.
profileSaveError: Profile was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
preferencesSyncError: Preferences are not synced. Check your connection and try again.
locationConsentBody: EvacuAid will upload this one position ({{latitude}}, {{longitude}}) to the server. Background tracking is not used.
locationSavedBody: This location is current for up to 15 minutes. Update it if you move.
locationPermissionDenied: Location permission was denied. You can enable it in device settings.
locationRetrieveError: GPS could not get your position. Try again where the GPS signal is stronger.
locationUploadError: The connection failed. Location was not saved; retry when your network is available.
shareLocationWithBuddies: Let active contacts see approximate distance
deleteProfileBody: Your profile, location, and buddy relationships will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
deleteProfileError: Profile was not deleted. Try again when connected.
guestSessionNote: Guest profile is tied to this device. If its token is lost, the profile cannot be recovered.
optionalName: Name is optional, up to 60 characters. Clear it to use the default greeting.
nameSaveError: Could not save your name. Your draft is still here. Try Save again.
discoverMapUnavailable: The map is unavailable. All example items remain available in the list below.
discoverMapLabel: Map of illustrative alerts and destinations
findShelterBody: EvacuAid uses your location once to calculate a walking route. It is not saved to your profile.
hazard_NO_KNOWN_HAZARD: No disaster reports along this route. This does not guarantee it is safe.
hazard_POTENTIALLY_EXPOSED: This route passes an area with disaster reports. Check conditions before you leave.
hazard_UNKNOWN: Route safety is not yet known.
routeAccess_COMPATIBLE: A walking path is available. Step-free access is not yet known.
routeAccess_POTENTIALLY_INCOMPATIBLE: This route may not match your access needs.
routeAccess_UNKNOWN: Step-free access on this route is not yet known.
externalNavigation: Navigation continues in another map app.
locationDeniedBody: Without your location, EvacuAid can’t calculate a route. You can allow it in Settings.
routeReason_NO_SUITABLE_SHELTER: No suitable gathering point within 10 km. Points that are full, closed or don’t match your access needs are skipped.
routeReason_ROUTING_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The routing service is unavailable right now. You can still open the list of gathering points.
routeReason_NO_ROUTE_AVAILABLE: No walking path was found to the nearest gathering points.
routeReason_default: The route can’t be calculated right now.
routeErrorConnection: Can’t reach EvacuAid. Check your connection, then try again.
routeErrorUnknown: Your location or the route couldn’t be read. Try again.
noSheltersBody: No gathering points are recorded within 10 km of you. Follow local officials’ directions.
onboardWarningTitle: This is how a warning will look.
needVisualDescription: Voice guidance, larger text, stronger contrast
needStandardDescription: You can still turn on support features one by one.
locationWhy: Needed to find routes and alert buddies
dataSourcesBody: Earthquakes: BMKG. Citizen reports: PetaBencana. Maps and walking routes: © OpenStreetMap contributors, routed with Valhalla.
